source.acceptance: acceptance-cases.json (WFA-T22 traversal, WFA-T33 SSRF/egress, WFA-T34 unsafe archives/prototype, WFA-T35 bounds)

note: Negative vectors for the leaf-node fences. Mock providers/receivers used by positive cases are LOOPBACK ONLY with a run-assigned port. Every ssrf vector below must be refused before network access; every traversal vector must be refused by archive_extract/file handling; prototype keys must be rejected by bindings.

loopbackMockPolicy.note: Mocks bind 127.0.0.1 only; ports are allocated per test run. https is not required for loopback mocks; non-loopback destinations are never used.

boundsNote: maxFanout has no frozen legacy number; the WFA-03 contract must declare an explicit bound before T35 can pass. Other values mirror the synthetic schema fixture conditions and are scaffolding defaults, not release limits.
